title: Testing Utilities
summary: This module provides various utilities for testing, including tools for parsing VCR cassettes, checking for orphaned cassettes, uploading test files to different providers, and verifying Google Cloud Storage (GCS) integration with Vertex AI.

nodes.label: Parse VCR Cassette
nodes.title: Parse VCR Cassette Files
nodes.description: Parses a specified VCR cassette YAML file, optionally focusing on a single interaction, to inspect recorded HTTP requests and responses.

nodes.label: Check Orphaned Cassettes
nodes.title: Check for Orphaned VCR Cassettes
nodes.description: Scans test modules and VCR cassette files to identify and report any cassettes that do not have a corresponding test, helping to clean up dead code.

nodes.label: Upload Test Files
nodes.title: Upload Test Files to Providers
nodes.description: Uploads various test files to different AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Bedrock) to facilitate testing of file-based inputs.

nodes.label: Verify Vertex GCS All Types
nodes.title: Verify Vertex AI GCS Integration for All File Types
nodes.description: Tests the integration of Vertex AI with Google Cloud Storage (GCS) across various file types, ensuring that models can correctly process GCS URIs.

nodes.label: Verify Vertex GCS Tool Result
nodes.title: Verify Vertex AI GCS Tool Result Handling
nodes.description: Verifies that Vertex AI models correctly handle GCS URIs provided within tool results, both directly in function responses and as separate file_data parts.

nodes.label: VCR Cassette Files
nodes.title: VCR Cassette Files
nodes.description: YAML files containing recorded HTTP interactions used for testing.

nodes.label: Test Modules
nodes.title: Python Test Modules
nodes.description: Python files containing unit and integration tests, often marked for VCR usage.

nodes.label: AI Model Providers
nodes.title: External AI Model Providers
nodes.description: Various AI model services like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Bedrock, used for testing file uploads and model interactions.

nodes.label: Google Cloud Storage
nodes.title: Google Cloud Storage (GCS)
nodes.description: Cloud object storage service used for hosting test files and verifying Vertex AI integration.

nodes.label: Google Vertex AI
nodes.title: Google Vertex AI
nodes.description: Google's unified machine learning platform, used for testing model interactions with GCS data.

groups.label: Cassette Management
groups.title: VCR Cassette Management
groups.description: Tools for inspecting and validating VCR (Video Cassette Recorder) HTTP interaction recordings used in tests.

groups.label: Cloud Service Testing
groups.title: Cloud Service Integration Testing
groups.description: Utilities for testing interactions with various cloud-based AI model providers and storage services.
